description: This file contains debugging utilities for the ANGLE project, including logging, debug annotations, and platform-specific debug output functions.

classes.name: LogMessage
classes.description: Handles log message creation and output, including severity and message formatting.

classes.name: ScopedPerfEventHelper
classes.description: Manages performance event scope for debugging, beginning and ending events.

methods.name: DebugAnnotationsActive
methods.description: Checks if debug annotations are active.

methods.name: DebugAnnotationsInitialized
methods.description: Checks if debug annotations have been initialized.

methods.name: InitializeDebugAnnotations
methods.description: Initializes debug annotations with a given DebugAnnotator.

methods.name: InitializeDebugMutexIfNeeded
methods.description: Creates a mutex for debugging if it hasn't been created yet.

methods.name: Trace
methods.description: Logs a trace message with a given severity.

methods.name: FmtHR
methods.description: Formats an HRESULT value as a hexadecimal string.

methods.name: FmtErr
methods.description: Formats a DWORD error code as a hexadecimal string.
